ko.title: 500만 달러 지급, 연방 소송 1건: 에반스턴의 배상 프로그램에 대한 법무부의 도전 속으로

segments.src: ## A First-of-Its-Kind Program Faces Its Biggest Test
segments.tr: ## 최초의 프로그램이 가장 큰 시험대에 오르다

segments.src: In 2019, the Evanston, Illinois City Council did something no U.S.
segments.tr: 2019년, 일리노이주 에반스턴 시의회는 미국 내 어떤

segments.src: municipality had done before: it voted to fund a local reparations program for Black residents harmed by decades of housing discrimination and redlining.
segments.tr: 지방자치단체도 이전에 하지 않았던 일을 해냈습니다. 수십 년간의 주거 차별과 레드라이닝(주거지 배제)으로 피해를 입은 흑인 주민들을 위한 지역 배상 프로그램에 재정을 지원하기로 의결한 것입니다.

segments.src: Seven years later, that program is at the center of a federal legal battle that could shape whether any American city can run a race-based reparations effort at all.
segments.tr: 7년이 지난 지금, 이 프로그램은 미국 도시가 인종에 기반한 배상 노력을 추진할 수 있는지 여부를 결정지을 수 있는 연방 법적 분쟁의 중심에 서 있습니다.

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: 미국

segments.src: Department of Justice has moved to intervene in a lawsuit against the city, arguing that Evanston's program amounts to unconstitutional racial discrimination.
segments.tr: 법무부는 에반스턴의 프로그램이 위헌적인 인종 차별에 해당한다고 주장하며 시를 상대로 한 소송에 개입하기로 신청했습니다.

segments.src: The case is being watched closely far beyond Illinois, since Evanston's program has long served as a model — and a test case — for reparations advocates across the country.
segments.tr: 에반스턴의 프로그램은 오랫동안 전국 배상 옹호자들에게 모델이자 시험 사례 역할을 해왔기 때문에 이 사건은 일리노이주를 넘어 광범위하게 주목받고 있습니다.

segments.src: ## How Evanston's Program Works
segments.tr: ## 에반스턴 프로그램의 작동 방식

segments.src: Evanston's "Restorative Housing Program" grew out of a 2019 City Council decision to dedicate the first $10 million collected from the city's 3% cannabis sales tax to reparations efforts.
segments.tr: 에반스턴의 "회복적 주거 프로그램(Restorative Housing Program)"은 시의 대마초 판매세 3% 중 첫 1,000만 달러를 배상 노력에 할당하기로 한 2019년 시의회의 결정에서 시작되었습니다.

segments.src: Approved in March 2021, the program offers qualifying Black residents grants of up to $25,000 that can be used toward a down payment, mortgage assistance or home repairs.
segments.tr: 2021년 3월에 승인된 이 프로그램은 자격을 갖춘 흑인 주민에게 주택 계약금, 주택담보대출 지원금 또는 주택 수리비로 사용할 수 있는 최대 25,000달러의 보조금을 제공합니다.

segments.src: To qualify, applicants must have lived in Evanston between 1919 and 1969 — the period during which the city enforced discriminatory housing policies — or be a direct descendant of someone who did.
segments.tr: 자격을 얻으려면 신청자는 시가 차별적인 주거 정책을 시행했던 기간인 1919년과 1969년 사이에 에반스턴에 거주했거나, 해당 기간 거주자의 직계 비속이어야 합니다.

segments.src: The city has said the program is meant to address documented harm from redlining and other housing discrimination, not to serve as a general benefit based on race alone.
segments.tr: 시 측은 이 프로그램이 단순히 인종만을 기준으로 한 일반적 혜택이 아니라, 레드라이닝과 기타 주거 차별로 인해 입증된 피해를 해결하기 위한 것이라고 밝혔습니다.

segments.src: According to court filings, the city has distributed more than $5 million to date, with additional payments planned as funding becomes available.
segments.tr: 법원 제출 문서에 따르면, 시는 현재까지 500만 달러 이상을 지급했으며, 자금이 확보되는 대로 추가 지급을 계획하고 있습니다.

segments.src: Early rounds of the program provided $25,000 each to dozens of residents, and city officials have said funding constraints — including softer-than-expected cannabis tax revenue — have slowed the pace of payments.
segments.tr: 프로그램의 초기 단계에서는 수십 명의 주민에게 각각 25,000달러를 제공했으며, 시 관계자들은 예상보다 저조한 대마초 세수 등 재정적 제약으로 인해 지급 속도가 느려졌다고 말했습니다.

segments.src: ## The Lawsuit That Started It All
segments.tr: ## 모든 것의 시작이 된 소송

segments.src: The legal challenge began in 2024, when a group of Evanston residents and descendants of former residents who are not Black filed suit in federal court.
segments.tr: 법적 분쟁은 2024년 흑인이 아닌 에반스턴 주민들과 전 주민의 후손들이 연방법원에 소송을 제기하면서 시작되었습니다.

segments.src: The case, *Flinn v.
segments.tr: *Flinn v.

segments.src: City of Evanston*, argues that excluding non-Black applicants from the program violates the Equal Protection Clause of the Fourteenth Amendment, which generally bars government programs from distributing benefits based on race.
segments.tr: City of Evanston* 사건은 비흑인 신청자를 프로그램에서 제외하는 것이 정부 프로그램이 인종에 기반하여 혜택을 나누어 주는 것을 일반적으로 금지하는 수정헌법 제14조의 평등보호조항을 위반한다고 주장합니다.

segments.src: The city sought to have the case dismissed, arguing the program was a narrowly tailored remedy for specific, documented discrimination rather than a broad racial preference.
segments.tr: 시는 이 프로그램이 광범위한 인종적 선호가 아니라 구체적이고 문서화된 차별에 대한 좁게 맞춤화된 구제책이라고 주장하며 소송 기각을 요청했습니다.

segments.src: A federal judge rejected that motion in March 2026, allowing the case to proceed — a ruling that opened the door for the Justice Department's involvement.
segments.tr: 연방법원 판사는 2026년 3월 그 요청을 거부하여 소송이 진행될 수 있도록 허용했으며, 이 판결은 법무부가 개입할 수 있는 길을 열어주었습니다.

segments.src: ## Why the DOJ Stepped In
segments.tr: ## 법무부가 개입한 이유

segments.src: Shortly after the dismissal was denied, the Justice Department's Civil Rights Division opened its own investigation into the Evanston program under the Equal Protection Clause and the federal Fair Housing Act.
segments.tr: 기각 신청이 거부된 직후, 법무부 민권국은 평등보호조항과 연방 공정주거법에 따라 에반스턴 프로그램에 대한 자체 조사에 착수했습니다.

segments.src: The department has said the city declined to cooperate with that inquiry, which prompted federal attorneys to seek to formally intervene in the private lawsuit rather than pursue a separate case.
segments.tr: 법무부는 시가 해당 조사에 협조하기를 거부했다고 밝혔으며, 이로 인해 연방 검사들은 별도의 소송을 제기하는 대신 민사 소송에 공식적으로 개입하려 시도하게 되었습니다.

segments.src: In its filings, the DOJ contends the government has what it calls an "unconditional right" to intervene in cases alleging the denial of equal protection based on race, and argues Evanston's program distributes cash and housing assistance "solely" on the basis of an applicant's race, rather than on individualized proof of harm.
segments.tr: 제출된 서류에서 법무부는 정부가 인종에 기반한 평등권 침해를 주장하는 사건에 개입할 수 있는 이른바 "무조건적 권리"를 가지고 있다고 주장하며, 에반스턴의 프로그램이 개별화된 피해 증명 없이 "오직" 신청자의 인종만을 기준으로 현금과 주거 지원을 배분한다고 지적합니다.

segments.src: The department's proposed complaint asks the court to find the program unlawful under both the Constitution and federal fair-housing law.
segments.tr: 법무부가 제출한 고소장안은 법원이 헌법과 연방 공정주거법 모두에 따라 해당 프로그램이 불법임을 확인해 줄 것을 요청하고 있습니다.

segments.src: Evanston officials and reparations advocates have pushed back, arguing the program is a targeted remedy grounded in a documented history of the city's own discriminatory housing practices between 1919 and 1969 — not an open-ended racial preference.
segments.tr: 에반스턴 시 관계자들과 배상 옹호자들은 이 프로그램이 무제한적인 인종적 선호가 아니라 1919년과 1969년 사이 시 자체의 차별적 주거 정책이라는 입증된 역사에 근거한 타깃형 구제책이라고 반박해 왔습니다.

segments.src: The city's Reparations Committee has said it remains committed to the program while the litigation continues, and some members have framed the case as a test of whether any local government can ever attempt to repair historical harm through direct, race-conscious remedies.
segments.tr: 시의 배상위원회는 소송이 진행되는 동안에도 프로그램에 계속 매진할 것이라고 밝혔으며, 일부 위원들은 이 사건을 지방정부가 직접적이고 인종을 고려한 구제책을 통해 역사적 피해를 복구하려는 시도를 할 수 있는지에 대한 시험대로 규정했습니다.

segments.src: ## Why This Case Matters Beyond Evanston
segments.tr: ## 이 사건이 에반스턴을 넘어 중요한 이유

segments.src: Evanston's program has been widely cited as a national blueprint since its launch, and other cities and states have looked to it while considering their own reparations proposals.
segments.tr: 에반스턴의 프로그램은 출범 이후 전국적인 청사진으로 널리 인용되어 왔으며, 다른 도시와 주들도 자체 배상안을 검토하면서 이 프로그램을 참고해 왔습니다.

segments.src: Legal observers note that a ruling against Evanston could make it significantly harder for other municipalities to design similar programs, while a ruling in the city's favor could bolster the legal footing for reparations efforts elsewhere.
segments.tr: 법률 전문가들은 에반스턴에 불리한 판결이 내려지면 다른 지자체가 유사한 프로그램을 설계하는 것이 훨씬 어려워질 수 있는 반면, 시에 유리한 판결이 나오면 다른 지역의 배상 노력에 법적 기반을 강화할 수 있다고 지적합니다.

segments.src: The case is still in its early stages in federal district court in Illinois, and a ruling on the merits is not expected imminently.
segments.tr: 이 사건은 일리노이주 연방지방법원에서 아직 초기 단계에 있으며, 본안 판결이 임박하게 나올 것으로 예상되지는 않습니다.

segments.src: Both the underlying *Flinn* lawsuit and the Justice Department's intervention will need to work through further briefing and, potentially, appeals — meaning the ultimate fate of Evanston's program, and its implications for reparations policy nationwide, likely remain months or years away from resolution.
segments.tr: 기초가 되는 *Flinn* 소송과 법무부의 개입 모두 추가적인 서면 제출과 잠재적인 항소 과정을 거쳐야 하므로, 에반스턴 프로그램의 최종 운명과 전국적인 배상 정책에 미칠 영향은 해결되기까지 수개월 또는 수년이 더 걸릴 것으로 보입니다.

segments.src: *This article summarizes publicly reported developments in ongoing litigation.
segments.tr: *본 기사는 진행 중인 소송에 대해 공개적으로 보도된 내용을 요약한 것입니다.

segments.src: It is intended for general informational purposes and does not constitute legal advice or analysis.*

zh.title: 已支付500万美元，面临一项联邦诉讼：探究司法部对埃文斯顿赔偿计划的挑战

segments.src: ## A First-of-Its-Kind Program Faces Its Biggest Test
segments.tr: ## 首创计划面临最大考验

segments.src: In 2019, the Evanston, Illinois City Council did something no U.S.
segments.tr: 2019年，伊利诺伊州埃文斯顿市议会做出了美国任何一个

segments.src: municipality had done before: it voted to fund a local reparations program for Black residents harmed by decades of housing discrimination and redlining.
segments.tr: 市镇此前都未曾做过的事：投票决定为受数十年住房歧视和红线政策伤害的黑人居民资助一项地方赔偿计划。

segments.src: Seven years later, that program is at the center of a federal legal battle that could shape whether any American city can run a race-based reparations effort at all.
segments.tr: 七年后，该计划正处于一场联邦法律斗争的中心，这场斗争可能决定美国是否有任何城市能够开展以种族为基础的赔偿工作。

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: 美国

segments.src: Department of Justice has moved to intervene in a lawsuit against the city, arguing that Evanston's program amounts to unconstitutional racial discrimination.
segments.tr: 司法部已采取行动介入针对该市的一起诉讼，主张埃文斯顿的计划构成了违宪的种族歧视。

segments.src: The case is being watched closely far beyond Illinois, since Evanston's program has long served as a model — and a test case — for reparations advocates across the country.
segments.tr: 伊利诺伊州以外的许多地方都在密切关注此案，因为埃文斯顿的计划长期以来一直是全国各地赔偿倡导者的模范和试验田。

segments.src: ## How Evanston's Program Works
segments.tr: ## 埃文斯顿计划的运作方式

segments.src: Evanston's "Restorative Housing Program" grew out of a 2019 City Council decision to dedicate the first $10 million collected from the city's 3% cannabis sales tax to reparations efforts.
segments.tr: 埃文斯顿的“恢复性住房计划”源于2019年市议会的一项决定，即把从该市3%的大麻销售税中收取的最初1000万美元专门用于赔偿工作。

segments.src: Approved in March 2021, the program offers qualifying Black residents grants of up to $25,000 that can be used toward a down payment, mortgage assistance or home repairs.
segments.tr: 该计划于2021年3月批准，为符合条件的黑人居民提供最高2.5万美元的补助金，这些资金可用于支付首付、按揭援助或房屋维修。

segments.src: To qualify, applicants must have lived in Evanston between 1919 and 1969 — the period during which the city enforced discriminatory housing policies — or be a direct descendant of someone who did.
segments.tr: 要获得资格，申请人必须在1919年至1969年期间——即该市实施歧视性住房政策的时期——住在埃文斯顿，或者是这样的人的直系后代。

segments.src: The city has said the program is meant to address documented harm from redlining and other housing discrimination, not to serve as a general benefit based on race alone.
segments.tr: 该市表示，该计划旨在解决因红线政策和其他住房歧视而造成的有据可查的伤害，而不是作为仅基于种族的普遍福利。

segments.src: According to court filings, the city has distributed more than $5 million to date, with additional payments planned as funding becomes available.
segments.tr: 根据法院文件，该市迄今已发放了超过500万美元，并计划在资金到位时进行额外支付。

segments.src: Early rounds of the program provided $25,000 each to dozens of residents, and city officials have said funding constraints — including softer-than-expected cannabis tax revenue — have slowed the pace of payments.
segments.tr: 该计划的早期阶段向数十名居民每人提供了2.5万美元，市官员表示，资金限制（包括低于预期的大麻税收入）放慢了支付步伐。

segments.src: ## The Lawsuit That Started It All
segments.tr: ## 一切开端的诉讼

segments.src: The legal challenge began in 2024, when a group of Evanston residents and descendants of former residents who are not Black filed suit in federal court.
segments.tr: 法律挑战始于2024年，当时一群埃文斯顿居民和前居民的非黑人后代在联邦法院提起诉讼。

segments.src: The case, *Flinn v.
segments.tr: 此案即*Flinn v.

segments.src: City of Evanston*, argues that excluding non-Black applicants from the program violates the Equal Protection Clause of the Fourteenth Amendment, which generally bars government programs from distributing benefits based on race.
segments.tr: City of Evanston*，主张将非黑人申请人排除在计划之外的行为违反了《宪法第十四修正案》的平等保护条款，该条款普遍禁止政府机构根据种族分发福利。

segments.src: The city sought to have the case dismissed, arguing the program was a narrowly tailored remedy for specific, documented discrimination rather than a broad racial preference.
segments.tr: 该市试图驳回该案，主张该计划是对特定、有据可查的歧视采取的狭隘定制补救措施，而不是广泛的种族偏好。

segments.src: A federal judge rejected that motion in March 2026, allowing the case to proceed — a ruling that opened the door for the Justice Department's involvement.
segments.tr: 一名联邦法官在2026年3月驳回了该动议，允许案件继续审理——这一裁决为司法部的介入打开了大门。

segments.src: ## Why the DOJ Stepped In
segments.tr: ## 司法部为何介入

segments.src: Shortly after the dismissal was denied, the Justice Department's Civil Rights Division opened its own investigation into the Evanston program under the Equal Protection Clause and the federal Fair Housing Act.
segments.tr: 驳回动议被拒后不久，司法部民权司根据平等保护条款和联邦《公平住房法》对埃文斯顿计划展开了自身的调查。

segments.src: The department has said the city declined to cooperate with that inquiry, which prompted federal attorneys to seek to formally intervene in the private lawsuit rather than pursue a separate case.
segments.tr: 该部门表示，该市拒绝配合该调查，这促使联邦律师寻求正式介入私人诉讼，而不是另案起诉。

segments.src: In its filings, the DOJ contends the government has what it calls an "unconditional right" to intervene in cases alleging the denial of equal protection based on race, and argues Evanston's program distributes cash and housing assistance "solely" on the basis of an applicant's race, rather than on individualized proof of harm.
segments.tr: 在其文件中，司法部坚称政府对涉嫌基于种族剥夺平等保护的案件拥有其所谓的“无条件介入权”，并主张埃文斯顿的计划“完全”根据申请人的种族而非个人受害证明来分发现金和住房援助。

segments.src: The department's proposed complaint asks the court to find the program unlawful under both the Constitution and federal fair-housing law.
segments.tr: 该部门提议的起诉书要求法院认定该计划违反了宪法和联邦公平住房法。

segments.src: Evanston officials and reparations advocates have pushed back, arguing the program is a targeted remedy grounded in a documented history of the city's own discriminatory housing practices between 1919 and 1969 — not an open-ended racial preference.
segments.tr: 埃文斯顿官员和赔偿倡导者进行了反击，主张该计划是一项有针对性的补救措施，立足于该市在1919年至1969年间自身歧视性住房做法的有据可查的历史，而不是一个开放式的种族偏好。

segments.src: The city's Reparations Committee has said it remains committed to the program while the litigation continues, and some members have framed the case as a test of whether any local government can ever attempt to repair historical harm through direct, race-conscious remedies.
segments.tr: 该市的赔偿委员会表示，在诉讼持续期间，它仍然致力于该计划，一些成员将此案定性为一场考验，即地方政府是否能够通过直接的、具有种族意识的补救措施来尝试修复历史伤害。

segments.src: ## Why This Case Matters Beyond Evanston
segments.tr: ## 为什么此案在埃文斯顿之外也很重要

segments.src: Evanston's program has been widely cited as a national blueprint since its launch, and other cities and states have looked to it while considering their own reparations proposals.
segments.tr: 埃文斯顿的计划自启动以来就被广泛誉为全国性的蓝图，其他城市和州在审议各自的赔偿提案时都将目光投向了它。

segments.src: Legal observers note that a ruling against Evanston could make it significantly harder for other municipalities to design similar programs, while a ruling in the city's favor could bolster the legal footing for reparations efforts elsewhere.
segments.tr: 法律观察人士指出，针对埃文斯顿的不利裁决可能会使其他市镇设计类似计划变得更加困难，而有利于该市的裁决则可能巩固其他地方赔偿工作的法律基础。

segments.src: The case is still in its early stages in federal district court in Illinois, and a ruling on the merits is not expected imminently.
segments.tr: 该案目前仍处于伊利诺伊州联邦地区法院的早期阶段，预计不会很快做出实质性裁决。

segments.src: Both the underlying *Flinn* lawsuit and the Justice Department's intervention will need to work through further briefing and, potentially, appeals — meaning the ultimate fate of Evanston's program, and its implications for reparations policy nationwide, likely remain months or years away from resolution.
segments.tr: 基础的*Flinn*诉讼以及司法部的介入都需要经历进一步的简短陈述和潜在的上诉——这意味着埃文斯顿计划的最终命运及其对全国赔偿政策的影响可能还需要数月或数年才能解决。

hi.title: $5 Million Paid, One Federal Lawsuit: Inside the Justice Department's Challenge to Evanston's Reparations Program

segments.src: ## A First-of-Its-Kind Program Faces Its Biggest Test
segments.tr: ## अपनी तरह का पहला कार्यक्रम अपनी सबसे बड़ी परीक्षा का सामना कर रहा है

segments.src: In 2019, the Evanston, Illinois City Council did something no U.S.
segments.tr: 2019 में, इवान्सटन, इलिनॉय नगर परिषद ने वह किया जो किसी भी अमेरिकी

segments.src: municipality had done before: it voted to fund a local reparations program for Black residents harmed by decades of housing discrimination and redlining.
segments.tr: नगर पालिका ने पहले कभी नहीं किया था: इसने दशकों के आवास भेदभाव और रेडलाइनिंग से पीड़ित काले निवासियों के लिए एक स्थानीय क्षतिपूर्ति (रेपेरेशन्स) कार्यक्रम को वित्तपोषित करने के लिए मतदान किया।

segments.src: Seven years later, that program is at the center of a federal legal battle that could shape whether any American city can run a race-based reparations effort at all.
segments.tr: सात साल बाद, वह कार्यक्रम एक संघीय कानूनी लड़ाई के केंद्र में है जो यह तय कर सकता है कि क्या कोई भी अमेरिकी शहर नस्ल-आधारित क्षतिपूर्ति प्रयास चला सकता है या नहीं।

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: यू.एस.

segments.src: Department of Justice has moved to intervene in a lawsuit against the city, arguing that Evanston's program amounts to unconstitutional racial discrimination.
segments.tr: न्याय विभाग ने शहर के खिलाफ एक मुकदमे में हस्तक्षेप करने के लिए कदम उठाया है, जिसमें यह तर्क दिया गया है कि इवान्सटन का कार्यक्रम असंवैधानिक नस्लीय भेदभाव के बराबर है।

segments.src: The case is being watched closely far beyond Illinois, since Evanston's program has long served as a model — and a test case — for reparations advocates across the country.
segments.tr: इलिनॉय से बहुत दूर इस मामले पर बारीकी से नजर रखी जा रही है, क्योंकि इवान्सटन का कार्यक्रम लंबे समय से देश भर के क्षतिपूर्ति समर्थकों के लिए एक मॉडल - और एक परीक्षण मामला - के रूप में कार्य करता रहा है।

segments.src: ## How Evanston's Program Works
segments.tr: ## इवान्सटन का कार्यक्रम कैसे काम करता है

segments.src: Evanston's "Restorative Housing Program" grew out of a 2019 City Council decision to dedicate the first $10 million collected from the city's 3% cannabis sales tax to reparations efforts.
segments.tr: इवान्सटन का "रेस्टोरेटिव हाउसिंग प्रोग्राम" 2019 के नगर परिषद के उस निर्णय से विकसित हुआ जिसमें शहर के 3% कैनबिनस बिक्री कर से एकत्र किए गए पहले $10 मिलियन को क्षतिपूर्ति प्रयासों के लिए समर्पित करने का निर्णय लिया गया था।

segments.src: Approved in March 2021, the program offers qualifying Black residents grants of up to $25,000 that can be used toward a down payment, mortgage assistance or home repairs.
segments.tr: मार्च 2021 में स्वीकृत, यह कार्यक्रम योग्य काले निवासियों को $25,000 तक के अनुदान प्रदान करता है जिनका उपयोग डाउन पेमेंट, मॉर्गेज सहायता या घर की मरम्मत के लिए किया जा सकता है।

segments.src: To qualify, applicants must have lived in Evanston between 1919 and 1969 — the period during which the city enforced discriminatory housing policies — or be a direct descendant of someone who did.
segments.tr: योग्यता प्राप्त करने के लिए, आवेदकों को 1919 और 1969 के बीच इवान्सटन में रहना चाहिए था - वह अवधि जिसके दौरान शहर ने भेदभावपूर्ण आवास नीतियों को लागू किया था - या किसी ऐसे व्यक्ति का सीधा वंशज होना चाहिए जो वहां रहा हो।

segments.src: The city has said the program is meant to address documented harm from redlining and other housing discrimination, not to serve as a general benefit based on race alone.
segments.tr: शहर ने कहा है कि इस कार्यक्रम का उद्देश्य रेडलाइनिंग और अन्य आवास भेदभाव से हुए प्रलेखित नुकसान को संबोधित करना है, न कि केवल नस्ल के आधार पर सामान्य लाभ प्रदान करना है।

segments.src: According to court filings, the city has distributed more than $5 million to date, with additional payments planned as funding becomes available.
segments.tr: अदालत के दस्तावेजों के अनुसार, शहर ने अब तक $5 मिलियन से अधिक का वितरण किया है, और फंड उपलब्ध होने पर अतिरिक्त भुगतान की योजना है।

segments.src: Early rounds of the program provided $25,000 each to dozens of residents, and city officials have said funding constraints — including softer-than-expected cannabis tax revenue — have slowed the pace of payments.
segments.tr: कार्यक्रम के शुरुआती दौर में दर्जनों निवासियों में से प्रत्येक को $25,000 प्रदान किए गए, और शहर के अधिकारियों ने कहा है कि फंड की कमी - जिसमें उम्मीद से कम कैनबिनस कर राजस्व शामिल है - ने भुगतान की गति को धीमा कर दिया है।

segments.src: ## The Lawsuit That Started It All
segments.tr: ## वह मुकदमा जहाँ से यह सब शुरू हुआ

segments.src: The legal challenge began in 2024, when a group of Evanston residents and descendants of former residents who are not Black filed suit in federal court.
segments.tr: कानूनी चुनौती 2024 में शुरू हुई, जब इवान्सटन के निवासियों और पूर्व निवासियों के वंशजों के एक समूह ने जो काले नहीं हैं, संघीय अदालत में मुकदमा दायर किया।

segments.src: The case, *Flinn v.
segments.tr: यह मामला, *Flinn v.

segments.src: City of Evanston*, argues that excluding non-Black applicants from the program violates the Equal Protection Clause of the Fourteenth Amendment, which generally bars government programs from distributing benefits based on race.
segments.tr: City of Evanston*, यह तर्क देता है कि कार्यक्रम से गैर-काले आवेदकों को बाहर करना चौदहवें संशोधन के समान सुरक्षा खंड का उल्लंघन करता है, जो आम तौर पर सरकारी कार्यक्रमों को नस्ल के आधार पर लाभ वितरित करने से रोकता है।

segments.src: The city sought to have the case dismissed, arguing the program was a narrowly tailored remedy for specific, documented discrimination rather than a broad racial preference.
segments.tr: शहर ने इस मामले को खारिज करने की मांग की, यह तर्क देते हुए कि व्यापक नस्लीय प्राथमिकता के बजाय यह कार्यक्रम विशिष्ट, प्रलेखित भेदभाव के लिए एक संकीर्ण रूप से तैयार किया गया उपाय था।

segments.src: A federal judge rejected that motion in March 2026, allowing the case to proceed — a ruling that opened the door for the Justice Department's involvement.
segments.tr: एक संघीय न्यायाधीश ने मार्च 2026 में उस प्रस्ताव को खारिज कर दिया, जिससे मामले को आगे बढ़ने की अनुमति मिल गई - एक ऐसा फैसला जिसने न्याय विभाग की संलिप्तता के द्वार खोल दिए।

segments.src: ## Why the DOJ Stepped In
segments.tr: ## डीओजे (DOJ) ने हस्तक्षेप क्यों किया

segments.src: Shortly after the dismissal was denied, the Justice Department's Civil Rights Division opened its own investigation into the Evanston program under the Equal Protection Clause and the federal Fair Housing Act.
segments.tr: खारिज किए जाने के तुरंत बाद, न्याय विभाग के नागरिक अधिकार प्रभाग ने समान सुरक्षा खंड और संघीय निष्पक्ष आवास अधिनियम के तहत इवान्सटन कार्यक्रम की अपनी जांच शुरू की।

segments.src: The department has said the city declined to cooperate with that inquiry, which prompted federal attorneys to seek to formally intervene in the private lawsuit rather than pursue a separate case.
segments.tr: विभाग ने कहा है कि शहर ने उस जांच में सहयोग करने से इनकार कर दिया, जिससे संघीय वकीलों को एक अलग मामला आगे बढ़ाने के बजाय निजी मुकदमे में औपचारिक रूप से हस्तक्षेप करने की मांग करने के लिए प्रेरित किया गया।

segments.src: In its filings, the DOJ contends the government has what it calls an "unconditional right" to intervene in cases alleging the denial of equal protection based on race, and argues Evanston's program distributes cash and housing assistance "solely" on the basis of an applicant's race, rather than on individualized proof of harm.
segments.tr: अपने दस्तावेजों में, डीओजे (DOJ) का तर्क है कि सरकार के पास वह है जिसे वह नस्ल के आधार पर समान सुरक्षा से इनकार करने का आरोप लगाने वाले मामलों में हस्तक्षेप करने का "बिना शर्त अधिकार" कहती है, और तर्क देती है कि इवान्सटन का कार्यक्रम नुकसान के व्यक्तिगत प्रमाण के बजाय, आवेदक की नस्ल के आधार पर "विशेष रूप से" नकद और आवास सहायता वितरित करता है।

segments.src: The department's proposed complaint asks the court to find the program unlawful under both the Constitution and federal fair-housing law.
segments.tr: विभाग की प्रस्तावित शिकायत अदालत से संविधान और संघीय निष्पक्ष-आवास कानून दोनों के तहत कार्यक्रम को गैरकानूनी घोषित करने के लिए कहती है।

segments.src: Evanston officials and reparations advocates have pushed back, arguing the program is a targeted remedy grounded in a documented history of the city's own discriminatory housing practices between 1919 and 1969 — not an open-ended racial preference.
segments.tr: इवान्सटन के अधिकारियों और क्षतिपूर्ति समर्थकों ने पीछे धकेलते हुए तर्क दिया है कि कार्यक्रम 1919 और 1969 के बीच शहर की अपनी भेदभावपूर्ण आवास प्रथाओं के प्रलेखित इतिहास पर आधारित एक लक्षित उपाय है - न कि एक खुली नस्लीय प्राथमिकता।

segments.src: The city's Reparations Committee has said it remains committed to the program while the litigation continues, and some members have framed the case as a test of whether any local government can ever attempt to repair historical harm through direct, race-conscious remedies.
segments.tr: शहर की क्षतिपूर्ति समिति ने कहा है कि मुकदमेबाजी जारी रहने के दौरान वह कार्यक्रम के प्रति प्रतिबद्ध है, और कुछ सदस्यों ने इस मामले को इस बात की परीक्षा के रूप में तैयार किया है कि क्या कोई स्थानीय सरकार कभी भी प्रत्यक्ष, नस्ल-सचेत उपायों के माध्यम से ऐतिहासिक नुकसान की भरपाई करने का प्रयास कर सकती है।

segments.src: ## Why This Case Matters Beyond Evanston
segments.tr: ## इवान्सटन से परे यह मामला क्यों महत्वपूर्ण है

segments.src: Evanston's program has been widely cited as a national blueprint since its launch, and other cities and states have looked to it while considering their own reparations proposals.
segments.tr: इवान्सटन के कार्यक्रम को इसकी शुरुआत के बाद से व्यापक रूप से एक राष्ट्रीय ब्लूप्रिंट के रूप में उद्धृत किया गया है, और अन्य शहरों और राज्यों ने अपने स्वयं के क्षतिपूर्ति प्रस्तावों पर विचार करते समय इसकी ओर देखा है।

segments.src: Legal observers note that a ruling against Evanston could make it significantly harder for other municipalities to design similar programs, while a ruling in the city's favor could bolster the legal footing for reparations efforts elsewhere.
segments.tr: कानूनी पर्यवेक्षकों का ध्यान है कि इवान्सटन के खिलाफ एक फैसला अन्य नगर पालिकाओं के लिए समान कार्यक्रमों को डिजाइन करना काफी कठिन बना सकता है, जबकि शहर के पक्ष में एक फैसला अन्य जगहों पर क्षतिपूर्ति प्रयासों के लिए कानूनी आधार को मजबूत कर सकता है।

segments.src: The case is still in its early stages in federal district court in Illinois, and a ruling on the merits is not expected imminently.
segments.tr: यह मामला इलिनॉय में संघीय जिला अदालत में अपने शुरुआती चरणों में है, और योग्यता पर फैसले की तुरंत उम्मीद नहीं है।

segments.src: Both the underlying *Flinn* lawsuit and the Justice Department's intervention will need to work through further briefing and, potentially, appeals — meaning the ultimate fate of Evanston's program, and its implications for reparations policy nationwide, likely remain months or years away from resolution.
segments.tr: अंतर्निहित *Flinn* मुकदमा और न्याय विभाग का हस्तक्षेप दोनों को आगे की ब्रीफिंग और, संभावित रूप से, अपीलों के माध्यम से काम करने की आवश्यकता होगी - जिसका अर्थ है कि इवान्सटन के कार्यक्रम का अंतिम भाग्य, और देश भर में क्षतिपूर्ति नीति के लिए इसके निहितार्थ, समाधान से महीनों या वर्षों दूर रहने की संभावना है।

segments.src: The case is being watched closely far beyond Illinois, since Evanston's program has long served as a model — and a test case — for reparations advocates across the country.

segments.src: ## How Evanston's Program Works
segments.tr: ## Cómo funciona el programa de Evanston

segments.src: Evanston's "Restorative Housing Program" grew out of a 2019 City Council decision to dedicate the first $10 million collected from the city's 3% cannabis sales tax to reparations efforts.
segments.tr: El "Programa de Vivienda Restaurativa" de Evanston surgió de una decisión del Ayuntamiento de 2019 de dedicar los primeros $10 millones recaudados del impuesto municipal del 3% sobre las ventas de cannabis a esfuerzos de reparación.

segments.src: Approved in March 2021, the program offers qualifying Black residents grants of up to $25,000 that can be used toward a down payment, mortgage assistance or home repairs.
segments.tr: Aprobado en marzo de 2021, el programa ofrece a los residentes negros que califican subvenciones de hasta $25,000 que pueden utilizarse para el pago inicial, asistencia hipotecaria o reparaciones del hogar.

segments.src: To qualify, applicants must have lived in Evanston between 1919 and 1969 — the period during which the city enforced discriminatory housing policies — or be a direct descendant of someone who did.
segments.tr: Para calificar, los solicitantes deben haber vivido en Evanston entre 1919 y 1969 —el período durante el cual la ciudad aplicó políticas de vivienda discriminatorias— o ser descendientes directos de alguien que lo hizo.

segments.src: The city has said the program is meant to address documented harm from redlining and other housing discrimination, not to serve as a general benefit based on race alone.
segments.tr: La ciudad ha dicho que el programa tiene como objetivo abordar el daño documentado por el redlining y otras formas de discriminación habitacional, no servir como un beneficio general basado únicamente en la raza.

segments.src: According to court filings, the city has distributed more than $5 million to date, with additional payments planned as funding becomes available.
segments.tr: Según los documentos judiciales, la ciudad ha distribuido más de $5 millones hasta la fecha, con pagos adicionales planificados a medida que haya fondos disponibles.

segments.src: Early rounds of the program provided $25,000 each to dozens of residents, and city officials have said funding constraints — including softer-than-expected cannabis tax revenue — have slowed the pace of payments.
segments.tr: Las primeras rondas del programa proporcionaron $25,000 cada una a decenas de residentes, y los funcionarios de la ciudad han dicho que las limitaciones de financiación —incluidos los ingresos por impuestos al cannabis más bajos de lo esperado— han ralentizado el ritmo de los pagos.

segments.src: ## The Lawsuit That Started It All
segments.tr: ## La demanda que lo inició todo

segments.src: The legal challenge began in 2024, when a group of Evanston residents and descendants of former residents who are not Black filed suit in federal court.
segments.tr: El desafío legal comenzó en 2024, cuando un grupo de residentes de Evanston y descendientes de antiguos residentes que no son negros presentaron una demanda en un tribunal federal.

segments.src: The case, *Flinn v.
segments.tr: El caso, *Flinn v.

segments.src: City of Evanston*, argues that excluding non-Black applicants from the program violates the Equal Protection Clause of the Fourteenth Amendment, which generally bars government programs from distributing benefits based on race.
segments.tr: City of Evanston*, argumenta que excluir a los solicitantes no negros del programa viola la Cláusula de Igualdad de Protección de la Decimocuarta Enmienda, que generalmente prohíbe a los programas gubernamentales distribuir beneficios basados en la raza.

segments.src: The city sought to have the case dismissed, arguing the program was a narrowly tailored remedy for specific, documented discrimination rather than a broad racial preference.
segments.tr: La ciudad intentó que se desestimara el caso, argumentando que el programa era un remedio diseñado específicamente para una discriminación documentada y concreta, en lugar de una preferencia racial amplia.

segments.src: A federal judge rejected that motion in March 2026, allowing the case to proceed — a ruling that opened the door for the Justice Department's involvement.
segments.tr: Un juez federal rechazó esa moción en marzo de 2026, permitiendo que el caso procediera; un fallo que abrió la puerta a la participación del Departamento de Justicia.

segments.src: ## Why the DOJ Stepped In
segments.tr: ## Por qué intervino el Departamento de Justicia

segments.src: Shortly after the dismissal was denied, the Justice Department's Civil Rights Division opened its own investigation into the Evanston program under the Equal Protection Clause and the federal Fair Housing Act.
segments.tr: Poco después de que se denegara la desestimación, la División de Derechos Civiles del Departamento de Justicia abrió su propia investigación sobre el programa de Evanston bajo la Cláusula de Igualdad de Protección y la Ley Federal de Vivienda Justa.

segments.src: The department has said the city declined to cooperate with that inquiry, which prompted federal attorneys to seek to formally intervene in the private lawsuit rather than pursue a separate case.
segments.tr: El departamento ha dicho que la ciudad se negó a cooperar con esa investigación, lo que llevó a los abogados federales a buscar intervenir formalmente en la demanda privada en lugar de iniciar un caso separado.

segments.src: In its filings, the DOJ contends the government has what it calls an "unconditional right" to intervene in cases alleging the denial of equal protection based on race, and argues Evanston's program distributes cash and housing assistance "solely" on the basis of an applicant's race, rather than on individualized proof of harm.
segments.tr: En sus presentaciones, el Departamento de Justicia sostiene que el gobierno tiene lo que llama un "derecho incondicional" a intervenir en casos que alegan la denegación de la igualdad de protección basada en la raza, y argumenta que el programa de Evanston distribuye efectivo y asistencia para la vivienda "únicamente" sobre la base de la raza del solicitante, en lugar de pruebas individualizadas de daño.

segments.src: The department's proposed complaint asks the court to find the program unlawful under both the Constitution and federal fair-housing law.
segments.tr: La demanda propuesta por el departamento pide al tribunal que declare el programa ilegal tanto bajo la Constitución como bajo la ley federal de vivienda justa.

segments.src: Evanston officials and reparations advocates have pushed back, arguing the program is a targeted remedy grounded in a documented history of the city's own discriminatory housing practices between 1919 and 1969 — not an open-ended racial preference.
segments.tr: Los funcionarios de Evanston y los defensores de las reparaciones han respondido, argumentando que el programa es un remedio dirigido basado en una historia documentada de las propias prácticas habitacionales discriminatorias de la ciudad entre 1919 y 1969, no una preferencia racial abierta.

segments.src: The city's Reparations Committee has said it remains committed to the program while the litigation continues, and some members have framed the case as a test of whether any local government can ever attempt to repair historical harm through direct, race-conscious remedies.
segments.tr: El Comité de Reparaciones de la ciudad ha dicho que sigue comprometido con el programa mientras continúa el litigio, y algunos miembros han enmarcado el caso como una prueba de si algún gobierno local puede intentar reparar el daño histórico a través de remedios directos y conscientes de la raza.

segments.src: ## Why This Case Matters Beyond Evanston
segments.tr: ## Por qué este caso importa más allá de Evanston

segments.src: Evanston's program has been widely cited as a national blueprint since its launch, and other cities and states have looked to it while considering their own reparations proposals.
segments.tr: El programa de Evanston ha sido ampliamente citado como un modelo nacional desde su lanzamiento, y otras ciudades y estados lo han tomado como referencia al considerar sus propias propuestas de reparación.

segments.src: Legal observers note that a ruling against Evanston could make it significantly harder for other municipalities to design similar programs, while a ruling in the city's favor could bolster the legal footing for reparations efforts elsewhere.
segments.tr: Los observadores legales señalan que un fallo contra Evanston podría hacer significativamente más difícil para otros municipios diseñar programas similares, mientras que un fallo a favor de la ciudad podría reforzar la base legal para los esfuerzos de reparación en otros lugares.

segments.src: The case is still in its early stages in federal district court in Illinois, and a ruling on the merits is not expected imminently.
segments.tr: El caso aún se encuentra en sus primeras etapas en el tribunal de distrito federal en Illinois, y no se espera un fallo sobre el fondo del asunto de forma inminente.

segments.src: Both the underlying *Flinn* lawsuit and the Justice Department's intervention will need to work through further briefing and, potentially, appeals — meaning the ultimate fate of Evanston's program, and its implications for reparations policy nationwide, likely remain months or years away from resolution.
segments.tr: Tanto la demanda subyacente *Flinn* como la intervención del Departamento de Justicia deberán pasar por más sesiones informativas y, potencialmente, apelaciones, lo que significa que el destino final del programa de Evanston, y sus implicaciones para la política de reparaciones a nivel nacional, probablemente tarden meses o años en resolverse.

segments.tr: Pour être admissibles, les candidats doivent avoir vécu à Evanston entre 1919 et 1969 — la période pendant laquelle la ville a appliqué des politiques de logement discriminatoires — ou être des descendants directs d'une telle personne.

segments.src: The city has said the program is meant to address documented harm from redlining and other housing discrimination, not to serve as a general benefit based on race alone.
segments.tr: La ville a déclaré que le programme vise à remédier aux préjudices documentés du redlining et d'autres discriminations au logement, et non à servir de prestation générale fondée uniquement sur la race.

segments.src: According to court filings, the city has distributed more than $5 million to date, with additional payments planned as funding becomes available.
segments.tr: Selon les documents judiciaires, la ville a distribué plus de 5 millions de dollars à ce jour, avec des paiements supplémentaires prévus à mesure que les fonds seront disponibles.

segments.src: Early rounds of the program provided $25,000 each to dozens of residents, and city officials have said funding constraints — including softer-than-expected cannabis tax revenue — have slowed the pace of payments.
segments.tr: Les premières phases du programme ont octroyé 25 000 dollars chacune à des dizaines de résidents, et les responsables municipaux ont indiqué que des contraintes financières — notamment des recettes fiscales sur le cannabis plus faibles que prévu — ont ralenti le rythme des versements.

segments.src: ## The Lawsuit That Started It All
segments.tr: ## Le procès qui a tout déclenché

segments.src: The legal challenge began in 2024, when a group of Evanston residents and descendants of former residents who are not Black filed suit in federal court.
segments.tr: La contestation juridique a débuté en 2024, lorsqu'un groupe de résidents d'Evanston et de descendants d'anciens résidents qui ne sont pas noirs a intenté une action en justice devant un tribunal fédéral.

segments.src: The case, *Flinn v.
segments.tr: L'affaire, *Flinn v.

segments.src: City of Evanston*, argues that excluding non-Black applicants from the program violates the Equal Protection Clause of the Fourteenth Amendment, which generally bars government programs from distributing benefits based on race.
segments.tr: City of Evanston*, soutient que l'exclusion des candidats non noirs du programme viole la clause d'égale protection du quatorzième amendement, qui interdit généralement aux programmes gouvernementaux de distribuer des avantages sur la base de la race.

segments.src: The city sought to have the case dismissed, arguing the program was a narrowly tailored remedy for specific, documented discrimination rather than a broad racial preference.
segments.tr: La ville a demandé le rejet de l'affaire, arguant que le programme constituait un remède ciblé pour une discrimination spécifique et documentée plutôt qu'une préférence raciale générale.

segments.src: A federal judge rejected that motion in March 2026, allowing the case to proceed — a ruling that opened the door for the Justice Department's involvement.
segments.tr: Un juge fédéral a rejeté cette motion en mars 2026, permettant à l'affaire de progresser — une décision qui a ouvert la voie à l'implication du ministère de la Justice.

segments.src: ## Why the DOJ Stepped In
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi le DOJ est intervenu

segments.src: Shortly after the dismissal was denied, the Justice Department's Civil Rights Division opened its own investigation into the Evanston program under the Equal Protection Clause and the federal Fair Housing Act.
segments.tr: Peu après le rejet de la requête en irrecevabilité, la division des droits civiques du ministère de la Justice a ouvert sa propre enquête sur le programme d'Evanston en vertu de la clause d'égale protection et de la loi fédérale sur le logement équitable (Fair Housing Act).

segments.src: The department has said the city declined to cooperate with that inquiry, which prompted federal attorneys to seek to formally intervene in the private lawsuit rather than pursue a separate case.
segments.tr: Le ministère a indiqué que la ville avait refusé de coopérer à cette enquête, ce qui a incité les avocats fédéraux à demander à intervenir formellement dans le procès privé plutôt qu'à intenter une action séparée.

segments.src: In its filings, the DOJ contends the government has what it calls an "unconditional right" to intervene in cases alleging the denial of equal protection based on race, and argues Evanston's program distributes cash and housing assistance "solely" on the basis of an applicant's race, rather than on individualized proof of harm.
segments.tr: Dans ses conclusions, le DOJ soutient que le gouvernement dispose de ce qu'il appelle un "droit inconditionnel" d'intervenir dans les affaires alléguant le refus d'une égale protection fondée sur la race, et affirme que le programme d'Evanston distribue de l'argent et une aide au logement "uniquement" sur la base de la race du demandeur, plutôt que sur la preuve individualisée d'un préjudice.

segments.src: The department's proposed complaint asks the court to find the program unlawful under both the Constitution and federal fair-housing law.
segments.tr: La plainte proposée par le ministère demande au tribunal de déclarer le programme illégal au regard de la Constitution et du droit fédéral du logement.

segments.src: Evanston officials and reparations advocates have pushed back, arguing the program is a targeted remedy grounded in a documented history of the city's own discriminatory housing practices between 1919 and 1969 — not an open-ended racial preference.
segments.tr: Les responsables d'Evanston et les défenseurs des réparations ont riposté, affirmant que le programme est un remède ciblé ancré dans une histoire documentée des pratiques de logement discriminatoires de la ville entre 1919 et 1969 — et non une préférence raciale ouverte.

segments.src: The city's Reparations Committee has said it remains committed to the program while the litigation continues, and some members have framed the case as a test of whether any local government can ever attempt to repair historical harm through direct, race-conscious remedies.
segments.tr: Le comité des réparations de la ville a déclaré qu'il restait engagé envers le programme pendant la poursuite du litige, et certains membres ont présenté l'affaire comme un test pour savoir si un gouvernement local peut un jour tenter de réparer un préjudice historique par des mesures correctives directes et conscientes de la race.

segments.src: ## Why This Case Matters Beyond Evanston
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi cette affaire dépasse le cadre d'Evanston

segments.src: Evanston's program has been widely cited as a national blueprint since its launch, and other cities and states have looked to it while considering their own reparations proposals.
segments.tr: Le programme d'Evanston a été largement cité comme un modèle national depuis son lancement, et d'autres villes et États s'en sont inspirés pour formuler leurs propres propositions de réparations.

segments.src: Legal observers note that a ruling against Evanston could make it significantly harder for other municipalities to design similar programs, while a ruling in the city's favor could bolster the legal footing for reparations efforts elsewhere.
segments.tr: Les observateurs juridiques soulignent qu'une décision contre Evanston pourrait rendre beaucoup plus difficile pour d'autres municipalités la conception de programmes similaires, tandis qu'une décision en faveur de la ville pourrait renforcer les bases juridiques des efforts de réparations ailleurs.

segments.src: The case is still in its early stages in federal district court in Illinois, and a ruling on the merits is not expected imminently.
segments.tr: L'affaire en est encore à ses débuts devant le tribunal de district fédéral de l'Illinois, et une décision sur le fond n'est pas attendue de sitôt.

segments.src: Both the underlying *Flinn* lawsuit and the Justice Department's intervention will need to work through further briefing and, potentially, appeals — meaning the ultimate fate of Evanston's program, and its implications for reparations policy nationwide, likely remain months or years away from resolution.
segments.tr: L'action en justice sous-jacente *Flinn* et l'intervention du ministère de la Justice devront faire l'objet de nouveaux mémoires et, potentiellement, d'appels — ce qui signifie que le sort final du programme d'Evanston, et ses implications pour la politique de réparations à l'échelle nationale, restent probablement à des mois, voire des années, d'une résolution.

segments.src: ## A First-of-Its-Kind Program Faces Its Biggest Test

segments.src: In 2019, the Evanston, Illinois City Council did something no U.S.

segments.tr: município dos EUA havia feito antes: votou para financiar um programa local de reparações para residentes negros prejudicados por décadas de discriminação habitacional e redlining.

segments.src: Seven years later, that program is at the center of a federal legal battle that could shape whether any American city can run a race-based reparations effort at all.
segments.tr: Sete anos depois, esse programa está no centro de uma batalha jurídica federal que pode definir se qualquer cidade americana pode executar um esforço de reparação baseado em raça.

segments.src: The U.S.

segments.src: ## How Evanston's Program Works

segments.src: Evanston's "Restorative Housing Program" grew out of a 2019 City Council decision to dedicate the first $10 million collected from the city's 3% cannabis sales tax to reparations efforts.
segments.tr: O "Programa de Habitação Restaurativa" de Evanston surgiu de uma decisão da Câmara Municipal de 2019 de dedicar os primeiros $10 milhões arrecadados com o imposto de 3% sobre vendas de cannabis da cidade para esforços de reparação.

segments.src: Approved in March 2021, the program offers qualifying Black residents grants of up to $25,000 that can be used toward a down payment, mortgage assistance or home repairs.
segments.tr: Aprovado em março de 2021, o programa oferece a residentes negros qualificados subsídios de até $25.000 que podem ser usados para entrada, assistência hipotecária ou reparos residenciais.

segments.src: To qualify, applicants must have lived in Evanston between 1919 and 1969 — the period during which the city enforced discriminatory housing policies — or be a direct descendant of someone who did.
segments.tr: Para se qualificar, os candidatos devem ter vivido em Evanston entre 1919 e 1969 — o período durante o qual a cidade aplicou políticas habitacionais discriminatórias — ou ser descendente direto de alguém que viveu.

segments.src: The city has said the program is meant to address documented harm from redlining and other housing discrimination, not to serve as a general benefit based on race alone.
segments.tr: A cidade afirmou que o programa visa abordar danos documentados decorrentes do redlining e de outras discriminações habitacionais, não servir como um benefício geral baseado apenas na raça.

segments.src: According to court filings, the city has distributed more than $5 million to date, with additional payments planned as funding becomes available.
segments.tr: De acordo com documentos judiciais, a cidade distribuiu mais de $5 milhões até o momento, com pagamentos adicionais planejados à medida que o financiamento estiver disponível.

segments.src: Early rounds of the program provided $25,000 each to dozens of residents, and city officials have said funding constraints — including softer-than-expected cannabis tax revenue — have slowed the pace of payments.
segments.tr: As primeiras rodadas do programa forneceram $25.000 cada para dezenas de residentes, e funcionários da cidade disseram que restrições de financiamento — incluindo receitas de impostos sobre cannabis mais fracas do que o esperado — desaceleraram o ritmo dos pagamentos.

segments.src: ## The Lawsuit That Started It All
segments.tr: ## O Processo que Começou Tudo

segments.src: The legal challenge began in 2024, when a group of Evanston residents and descendants of former residents who are not Black filed suit in federal court.
segments.tr: O desafio legal começou em 2024, quando um grupo de residentes de Evanston e descendentes de ex-residentes que não são negros entrou com uma ação em um tribunal federal.

segments.src: The case, *Flinn v.
segments.tr: O caso, *Flinn v.

segments.src: City of Evanston*, argues that excluding non-Black applicants from the program violates the Equal Protection Clause of the Fourteenth Amendment, which generally bars government programs from distributing benefits based on race.
segments.tr: City of Evanston*, argumenta que excluir candidatos não negros do programa viola a Cláusula de Proteção Igualitária da Décima Quarta Emenda, que geralmente proíbe programas governamentais de distribuir benefícios com base na raça.

segments.src: The city sought to have the case dismissed, arguing the program was a narrowly tailored remedy for specific, documented discrimination rather than a broad racial preference.
segments.tr: A cidade tentou fazer com que o caso fosse arquivado, argumentando que o programa era um remédio estritamente adaptado para uma discriminação específica e documentada, em vez de uma preferência racial ampla.

segments.src: A federal judge rejected that motion in March 2026, allowing the case to proceed — a ruling that opened the door for the Justice Department's involvement.
segments.tr: Um juiz federal rejeitou essa moção em março de 2026, permitindo que o caso prosseguisse — uma decisão que abriu as portas para o envolvimento do Departamento de Justiça.

segments.src: ## Why the DOJ Stepped In
segments.tr: ## Por Que o DOJ Interveio

segments.src: Shortly after the dismissal was denied, the Justice Department's Civil Rights Division opened its own investigation into the Evanston program under the Equal Protection Clause and the federal Fair Housing Act.
segments.tr: Pouco depois da negação do arquivamento, a Divisão de Direitos Civis do Departamento de Justiça abriu sua própria investigação sobre o programa de Evanston sob a Cláusula de Proteção Igualitária e a Lei Federal de Habitação Justa.

segments.src: The department has said the city declined to cooperate with that inquiry, which prompted federal attorneys to seek to formally intervene in the private lawsuit rather than pursue a separate case.
segments.tr: O departamento disse que a cidade se recusou a cooperar com essa investigação, o que levou os advogados federais a buscar intervir formalmente no processo privado em vez de buscar um caso separado.

segments.src: In its filings, the DOJ contends the government has what it calls an "unconditional right" to intervene in cases alleging the denial of equal protection based on race, and argues Evanston's program distributes cash and housing assistance "solely" on the basis of an applicant's race, rather than on individualized proof of harm.
segments.tr: Em seus documentos, o DOJ sustenta que o governo tem o que chama de "direito incondicional" de intervir em casos que alegam a negação de proteção igualitária com base na raça, e argumenta que o programa de Evanston distribui dinheiro e assistência habitacional "exclusivamente" com base na raça do candidato, em vez de provas individualizadas de dano.

segments.src: The department's proposed complaint asks the court to find the program unlawful under both the Constitution and federal fair-housing law.
segments.tr: A denúncia proposta pelo departamento pede ao tribunal que considere o programa ilegal sob a Constituição e a lei federal de habitação justa.

segments.src: Evanston officials and reparations advocates have pushed back, arguing the program is a targeted remedy grounded in a documented history of the city's own discriminatory housing practices between 1919 and 1969 — not an open-ended racial preference.
segments.tr: Funcionários de Evanston e defensores de reparações reagiram, argumentando que o programa é um remédio direcionado baseado em um histórico documentado das próprias práticas habitacionais discriminatórias da cidade entre 1919 e 1969 — não uma preferência racial aberta.

segments.src: The city's Reparations Committee has said it remains committed to the program while the litigation continues, and some members have framed the case as a test of whether any local government can ever attempt to repair historical harm through direct, race-conscious remedies.
segments.tr: O Comitê de Reparações da cidade disse que permanece comprometido com o programa enquanto o litígio continua, e alguns membros enquadraram o caso como um teste de se qualquer governo local pode tentar reparar danos históricos por meio de remédios diretos e conscientes da raça.

segments.src: ## Why This Case Matters Beyond Evanston
segments.tr: ## Por Que Este Caso Importa Além de Evanston

segments.src: Evanston's program has been widely cited as a national blueprint since its launch, and other cities and states have looked to it while considering their own reparations proposals.
segments.tr: O programa de Evanston tem sido amplamente citado como um projeto nacional desde o seu lançamento, e outras cidades e estados olharam para ele ao considerar suas próprias propostas de reparação.

segments.src: Legal observers note that a ruling against Evanston could make it significantly harder for other municipalities to design similar programs, while a ruling in the city's favor could bolster the legal footing for reparations efforts elsewhere.
segments.tr: Observadores jurídicos notam que uma decisão contra Evanston poderia tornar significativamente mais difícil para outros municípios projetarem programas semelhantes, enquanto uma decisão a favor da cidade poderia fortalecer a base legal para esforços de reparação em outros lugares.

segments.src: The case is still in its early stages in federal district court in Illinois, and a ruling on the merits is not expected imminently.
segments.tr: O caso ainda está em seus estágios iniciais no tribunal distrital federal em Illinois, e uma decisão sobre o mérito não é esperada para breve.

segments.src: Both the underlying *Flinn* lawsuit and the Justice Department's intervention will need to work through further briefing and, potentially, appeals — meaning the ultimate fate of Evanston's program, and its implications for reparations policy nationwide, likely remain months or years away from resolution.

segments.src: ## The Lawsuit That Started It All

segments.src: ## Why the DOJ Stepped In

segments.tr: Para pejabat Evanston dan pendukung reparasi telah melawan, dengan alasan bahwa program tersebut adalah pemulihan yang ditargetkan yang didasarkan pada sejarah terdokumentasi dari praktik perumahan diskriminatif kota itu sendiri antara tahun 1919 dan 1969 — bukan preferensi rasial yang terbuka.

segments.src: The city's Reparations Committee has said it remains committed to the program while the litigation continues, and some members have framed the case as a test of whether any local government can ever attempt to repair historical harm through direct, race-conscious remedies.
segments.tr: Komite Reparasi kota telah mengatakan bahwa mereka tetap berkomitmen pada program tersebut sementara litigasi berlanjut, dan beberapa anggota telah membingkai kasus tersebut sebagai ujian apakah ada pemerintah lokal yang dapat pernah mencoba untuk memperbaiki kerugian historis melalui pemulihan langsung yang sadar ras.

segments.src: ## Why This Case Matters Beyond Evanston
segments.tr: ## Mengapa Kasus Ini Penting di Luar Evanston

segments.src: Evanston's program has been widely cited as a national blueprint since its launch, and other cities and states have looked to it while considering their own reparations proposals.
segments.tr: Program Evanston telah banyak dikutip sebagai cetak biru nasional sejak peluncurannya, dan kota-kota serta negara bagian lain telah melihatnya saat mempertimbangkan proposal reparasi mereka sendiri.

segments.src: Legal observers note that a ruling against Evanston could make it significantly harder for other municipalities to design similar programs, while a ruling in the city's favor could bolster the legal footing for reparations efforts elsewhere.
segments.tr: Pengamat hukum mencatat bahwa keputusan yang menentang Evanston dapat membuat munisipalitas lain jauh lebih sulit untuk merancang program serupa, sementara keputusan yang memihak kota dapat memperkuat pijakan hukum untuk upaya reparasi di tempat lain.

segments.src: The case is still in its early stages in federal district court in Illinois, and a ruling on the merits is not expected imminently.
segments.tr: Kasus ini masih pada tahap awal di pengadilan distrik federal di Illinois, dan keputusan atas substansi tidak diharapkan dalam waktu dekat.

segments.src: Both the underlying *Flinn* lawsuit and the Justice Department's intervention will need to work through further briefing and, potentially, appeals — meaning the ultimate fate of Evanston's program, and its implications for reparations policy nationwide, likely remain months or years away from resolution.

ja.title: 500万ドルの支払いと連邦訴訟：エバンストンの賠償プログラムに対する司法省の挑戦の内幕

segments.src: ## A First-of-Its-Kind Program Faces Its Biggest Test
segments.tr: ## 初の試みが最大の試練に直面

segments.src: In 2019, the Evanston, Illinois City Council did something no U.S.
segments.tr: 2019年、イリノイ州エバンストン市議会は米国の

segments.src: municipality had done before: it voted to fund a local reparations program for Black residents harmed by decades of housing discrimination and redlining.
segments.tr: 自治体として初めて、数十年にわたる住宅差別とレッドライニング（住宅ローン差別）によって被害を受けた黒人住民のための地域賠償プログラムに資金を提供することを決議しました。

segments.src: Seven years later, that program is at the center of a federal legal battle that could shape whether any American city can run a race-based reparations effort at all.
segments.tr: 7年後、そのプログラムは、米国のどの都市であっても人種に基づく賠償の取り組みを実施できるかどうかを左右しかねない連邦法廷闘争の中心となっています。

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: 米国

segments.src: Department of Justice has moved to intervene in a lawsuit against the city, arguing that Evanston's program amounts to unconstitutional racial discrimination.
segments.tr: 司法省は、エバンストンのプログラムは違憲の人種差別に当たると主張し、市に対する訴訟への介入に乗り出しました。

segments.src: The case is being watched closely far beyond Illinois, since Evanston's program has long served as a model — and a test case — for reparations advocates across the country.
segments.tr: エバンストンのプログラムは長年、全米の賠償推進派にとってモデルであり、試金石となってきたため、この裁判はイリノイ州をはるかに超えて注目されています。

segments.src: ## How Evanston's Program Works
segments.tr: ## エバンストンのプログラムの仕組み

segments.src: Evanston's "Restorative Housing Program" grew out of a 2019 City Council decision to dedicate the first $10 million collected from the city's 3% cannabis sales tax to reparations efforts.
segments.tr: エバンストンの「修復的住宅プログラム（Restorative Housing Program）」は、市の大麻売上税（3%）から徴収された最初の1,000万ドルを賠償の取り組みに充てるという2019年の市議会の決定から生まれました。

segments.src: Approved in March 2021, the program offers qualifying Black residents grants of up to $25,000 that can be used toward a down payment, mortgage assistance or home repairs.
segments.tr: 2021年3月に承認されたこのプログラムは、資格のある黒人住民に対し、頭金、住宅ローン支援、または住宅修理に使用できる最大2万5,000ドルの助成金を提供するものです。

segments.src: To qualify, applicants must have lived in Evanston between 1919 and 1969 — the period during which the city enforced discriminatory housing policies — or be a direct descendant of someone who did.
segments.tr: 資格を得るには、申請者は市が差別的な住宅政策を施行していた1919年から1969年の間にエバンストンに居住していたか、居住していた人物の直系の子孫である必要があります。

segments.src: The city has said the program is meant to address documented harm from redlining and other housing discrimination, not to serve as a general benefit based on race alone.
segments.tr: 市は、このプログラムはレッドライニングやその他の住宅差別による文書化された被害に対処するためのものであり、人種のみに基づく一般的な給付を目的としたものではないと述べています。

segments.src: According to court filings, the city has distributed more than $5 million to date, with additional payments planned as funding becomes available.
segments.tr: 裁判資料によると、市は現在までに500万ドル以上を分配しており、資金が利用可能になり次第、追加の支払いを行う予定です。

segments.src: Early rounds of the program provided $25,000 each to dozens of residents, and city officials have said funding constraints — including softer-than-expected cannabis tax revenue — have slowed the pace of payments.
segments.tr: プログラムの初期段階では数十人の住民にそれぞれ2万5,000ドルが提供されましたが、市当局は、予想を下回る大麻税収などの資金制約により、支払いのペースが鈍化していると述べています。

segments.src: ## The Lawsuit That Started It All
segments.tr: ## すべての始まりとなった訴訟

segments.src: The legal challenge began in 2024, when a group of Evanston residents and descendants of former residents who are not Black filed suit in federal court.
segments.tr: 法的な異議申し立ては2024年に始まりました。当時、黒人ではないエバンストンの住民および元住民の子孫のグループが連邦裁判所に提訴したのです。

segments.src: The case, *Flinn v.
segments.tr: この裁判、*Flinn v.

segments.src: City of Evanston*, argues that excluding non-Black applicants from the program violates the Equal Protection Clause of the Fourteenth Amendment, which generally bars government programs from distributing benefits based on race.
segments.tr: City of Evanston*では、黒人以外の申請者をプログラムから除外することは、人種に基づいて利益を分配する政府プログラムを一般的に禁止している合衆国憲法修正第14条の平等保護条項に違反すると主張しています。

segments.src: The city sought to have the case dismissed, arguing the program was a narrowly tailored remedy for specific, documented discrimination rather than a broad racial preference.
segments.tr: 市は、このプログラムは広範な人種的優遇措置ではなく、特定の文書化された差別に対する厳密に調整された救済策であると主張し、訴訟の却下を求めました。

segments.src: A federal judge rejected that motion in March 2026, allowing the case to proceed — a ruling that opened the door for the Justice Department's involvement.
segments.tr: 連邦判事は2026年3月にその申し立てを却下し、裁判の進行を認めました。この判決が、司法省の介入への道を開くこととなりました。

segments.src: ## Why the DOJ Stepped In
segments.tr: ## 司法省が介入した理由

segments.src: Shortly after the dismissal was denied, the Justice Department's Civil Rights Division opened its own investigation into the Evanston program under the Equal Protection Clause and the federal Fair Housing Act.
segments.tr: 却下の申し立てが退けられた直後、司法省の公民権局は、平等保護条項および連邦公正住宅法に基づき、エバンストンのプログラムに対する独自の調査を開始しました。

segments.src: The department has said the city declined to cooperate with that inquiry, which prompted federal attorneys to seek to formally intervene in the private lawsuit rather than pursue a separate case.
segments.tr: 司法省によると、市はその調査への協力を拒否したため、連邦検察官は別の訴訟を起こすのではなく、民事訴訟に正式に介入することを求めたとのことです。

segments.src: In its filings, the DOJ contends the government has what it calls an "unconditional right" to intervene in cases alleging the denial of equal protection based on race, and argues Evanston's program distributes cash and housing assistance "solely" on the basis of an applicant's race, rather than on individualized proof of harm.
segments.tr: 司法省は提出書類の中で、政府には人種に基づく平等保護の否定を申し立てる訴訟に介入する「無条件の権利」があると主張し、エバンストンのプログラムは個別の被害証明ではなく、申請者の人種のみに基づいて現金や住宅支援を分配していると論じています。

segments.src: The department's proposed complaint asks the court to find the program unlawful under both the Constitution and federal fair-housing law.
segments.tr: 司法省の申し立て案は、憲法および連邦公正住宅法の両方に照らして、このプログラムを違法と判断するよう裁判所に求めています。

segments.src: Evanston officials and reparations advocates have pushed back, arguing the program is a targeted remedy grounded in a documented history of the city's own discriminatory housing practices between 1919 and 1969 — not an open-ended racial preference.
segments.tr: エバンストンの当局者や賠償推進派は、このプログラムは1919年から1969年の間に市自身が行った差別的な住宅慣行という文書化された歴史に基づいた対象を絞った救済策であり、無制限の人種的優遇措置ではないと反論しています。

segments.src: The city's Reparations Committee has said it remains committed to the program while the litigation continues, and some members have framed the case as a test of whether any local government can ever attempt to repair historical harm through direct, race-conscious remedies.
segments.tr: 市の賠償委員会は、訴訟が続く間もプログラムへの取り組みを継続すると述べており、一部のメンバーは、この裁判を、地方自治体が直接的かつ人種を意識した救済策を通じて歴史的な被害を修復しようとすることが可能かどうかを問う試金石であると位置づけています。

segments.src: ## Why This Case Matters Beyond Evanston
segments.tr: ## この裁判がエバンストン以外でも重要な理由

segments.src: Evanston's program has been widely cited as a national blueprint since its launch, and other cities and states have looked to it while considering their own reparations proposals.
segments.tr: エバンストンのプログラムは開始以来、全国的な青写真として広く引用されており、他の都市や州も独自の賠償案を検討する際にこのプログラムを参考にしています。

segments.src: Legal observers note that a ruling against Evanston could make it significantly harder for other municipalities to design similar programs, while a ruling in the city's favor could bolster the legal footing for reparations efforts elsewhere.
segments.tr: 法律専門家は、エバンストンに不利な判決が下されれば、他の自治体が同様のプログラムを設計することが著しく困難になる可能性がある一方、市に有利な判決が下されれば、他地域での賠償の取り組みの法的根拠が強化される可能性があると指摘しています。

segments.src: The case is still in its early stages in federal district court in Illinois, and a ruling on the merits is not expected imminently.
segments.tr: この裁判はイリノイ州の連邦地方裁判所でまだ初期段階にあり、本案に関する判決がすぐに出ることは予想されていません。

segments.src: Both the underlying *Flinn* lawsuit and the Justice Department's intervention will need to work through further briefing and, potentially, appeals — meaning the ultimate fate of Evanston's program, and its implications for reparations policy nationwide, likely remain months or years away from resolution.
segments.tr: 根底にある*Flinn*訴訟と司法省の介入の両方が、さらなる準備書面の提出や、場合によっては控訴を経て進められる必要があり、つまり、エバンストンのプログラムの最終的な運命と、それが全米の賠償政策に与える影響が解決に至るまでには、おそらく数ヶ月から数年かかるでしょう。

segments.src: ## Why the DOJ Stepped In

segments.tr: Der Klageentwurf des Ministeriums fordert das Gericht auf, das Programm sowohl nach der Verfassung als auch nach dem Bundesrecht für faire Wohnungspolitik für rechtswidrig zu erklären.

segments.src: ## Why This Case Matters Beyond Evanston
segments.tr: ## Warum dieser Fall über Evanston hinaus von Bedeutung ist

segments.tr: Der Fall befindet sich noch in einem frühen Stadium vor dem Bundesbezirksgericht in Illinois, und ein Urteil in der Sache wird nicht unmittelbar erwartet.

segments.src: Both the underlying *Flinn* lawsuit and the Justice Department's intervention will need to work through further briefing and, potentially, appeals — meaning the ultimate fate of Evanston's program, and its implications for reparations policy nationwide, likely remain months or years away from resolution.
segments.tr: Zusätzliche Schriftsätze und potenziell Berufungsverfahren werden sowohl für die zugrunde liegende *Flinn*-Klage als auch für das Eingreifen des Justizministeriums erforderlich sein — was bedeutet, dass das endgültige Schicksal des Programms von Evanston und seine Auswirkungen auf die Reparationspolitik bundesweit voraussichtlich noch Monate oder Jahre von einer Entscheidung entfernt sind.

vi.title: Đã Trả 5 Triệu Đô La, Một Vụ Kiện Liên Bang: Bên Trong Thử Thách Của Bộ Tư Pháp Đối Với Chương Trình Bồi Thường Của Evanston

segments.src: ## A First-of-Its-Kind Program Faces Its Biggest Test
segments.tr: ## Chương Trình Đầu Tiên Của Loại Hình Này Phải Đối Mặt Với Thử Thách Lớn Nhất

segments.src: In 2019, the Evanston, Illinois City Council did something no U.S.
segments.tr: Vào năm 2019, Hội đồng Thành phố Evanston, Illinois đã làm điều mà chưa có khu tự trị nào của Hoa Kỳ

segments.src: municipality had done before: it voted to fund a local reparations program for Black residents harmed by decades of housing discrimination and redlining.
segments.tr: từng làm trước đây: hội đồng đã bỏ phiếu tài trợ cho một chương trình bồi thường địa phương dành cho cư dân da màu bị tổn hại bởi nhiều thập kỷ phân biệt đối xử nhà ở và phân vùng đỏ.

segments.src: Seven years later, that program is at the center of a federal legal battle that could shape whether any American city can run a race-based reparations effort at all.
segments.tr: Bảy năm sau, chương trình đó đang nằm ở tâm điểm của một cuộc chiến pháp lý liên bang có thể định hình liệu bất kỳ thành phố nào của Mỹ có thể điều hành nỗ lực bồi thường dựa trên chủng tộc hay không.

segments.src: The U.S.
segments.tr: Bộ

segments.src: Department of Justice has moved to intervene in a lawsuit against the city, arguing that Evanston's program amounts to unconstitutional racial discrimination.
segments.tr: Tư pháp Hoa Kỳ đã tiến hành can thiệp vào một vụ kiện chống lại thành phố, lập luận rằng chương trình của Evanston tương đương với hành vi phân biệt chủng tộc vi hiến.

segments.src: The case is being watched closely far beyond Illinois, since Evanston's program has long served as a model — and a test case — for reparations advocates across the country.
segments.tr: Vụ việc đang được theo dõi chặt chẽ vượt ra ngoài biên giới Illinois, kể từ khi chương trình của Evanston từ lâu đã đóng vai trò là một mô hình — và một vụ án thử nghiệm — cho những người ủng hộ bồi thường trên khắp cả nước.

segments.src: ## How Evanston's Program Works
segments.tr: ## Chương Trình Của Evanston Hoạt Động Như Thế Nào

segments.src: Evanston's "Restorative Housing Program" grew out of a 2019 City Council decision to dedicate the first $10 million collected from the city's 3% cannabis sales tax to reparations efforts.
segments.tr: "Chương Trình Nhà Ở Phục Hồi" của Evanston xuất phát từ quyết định năm 2019 của Hội đồng Thành phố nhằm dành 10 triệu đô la đầu tiên thu được từ thuế doanh thu cần sa 3% của thành phố cho các nỗ lực bồi thường.

segments.src: Approved in March 2021, the program offers qualifying Black residents grants of up to $25,000 that can be used toward a down payment, mortgage assistance or home repairs.
segments.tr: Được phê duyệt vào tháng 3 năm 2021, chương trình cung cấp cho cư dân da màu đủ điều kiện các khoản tài trợ lên tới $25,000 có thể được sử dụng cho khoản trả trước, hỗ trợ thế chấp hoặc sửa chữa nhà ở.

segments.src: To qualify, applicants must have lived in Evanston between 1919 and 1969 — the period during which the city enforced discriminatory housing policies — or be a direct descendant of someone who did.
segments.tr: Để đủ điều kiện, người nộp đơn phải từng sống ở Evanston trong khoảng thời gian từ năm 1919 đến năm 1969 — giai đoạn thành phố thực thi các chính sách nhà ở mang tính phân biệt đối xử — hoặc là hậu duệ trực hệ của một người đã từng sống ở đó.

segments.src: The city has said the program is meant to address documented harm from redlining and other housing discrimination, not to serve as a general benefit based on race alone.
segments.tr: Thành phố cho biết chương trình này nhằm giải quyết những thiệt hại đã được tài liệu hóa từ việc phân vùng đỏ và các hành vi phân biệt đối xử nhà ở khác, chứ không phải để phục vụ như một phúc lợi chung chỉ dựa trên chủng tộc.

segments.src: According to court filings, the city has distributed more than $5 million to date, with additional payments planned as funding becomes available.
segments.tr: Theo hồ sơ tòa án, thành phố đã phân phối hơn $5 triệu cho đến nay, với các khoản thanh toán bổ sung được lên kế hoạch khi có sẵn nguồn vốn.

segments.src: Early rounds of the program provided $25,000 each to dozens of residents, and city officials have said funding constraints — including softer-than-expected cannabis tax revenue — have slowed the pace of payments.
segments.tr: Các vòng đầu của chương trình đã cung cấp $25,000 cho mỗi người cho hàng chục cư dân, và các quan chức thành phố cho biết các hạn chế về tài trợ — bao gồm doanh thu thuế cần sa thấp hơn dự kiến — đã làm chậm tốc độ thanh toán.

segments.src: ## The Lawsuit That Started It All
segments.tr: ## Vụ Kiện Đã Khơi Mào Tất Cả

segments.src: The legal challenge began in 2024, when a group of Evanston residents and descendants of former residents who are not Black filed suit in federal court.
segments.tr: Thách thức pháp lý bắt đầu vào năm 2024, khi một nhóm cư dân Evanston và hậu duệ của cựu cư dân không phải là người da màu đã đệ đơn kiện lên tòa án liên bang.

segments.src: The case, *Flinn v.
segments.tr: Vụ án, *Flinn kiện

segments.src: City of Evanston*, argues that excluding non-Black applicants from the program violates the Equal Protection Clause of the Fourteenth Amendment, which generally bars government programs from distributing benefits based on race.
segments.tr: Thành phố Evanston*, lập luận rằng việc loại trừ những người nộp đơn không phải là người da màu khỏi chương trình vi phạm Điều khoản Bảo vệ Bình đẳng của Tu sửa án thứ Mười Tư, vốn thường cấm các chương trình của chính phủ phân phối phúc lợi dựa trên chủng tộc.

segments.src: The city sought to have the case dismissed, arguing the program was a narrowly tailored remedy for specific, documented discrimination rather than a broad racial preference.
segments.tr: Thành phố đã tìm cách bác bỏ vụ kiện, lập luận rằng chương trình là một biện pháp khắc phục được thiết kế hẹp cho sự phân biệt đối xử cụ thể, có tài liệu thay vì ưu tiên chủng tộc rộng rãi.

segments.src: A federal judge rejected that motion in March 2026, allowing the case to proceed — a ruling that opened the door for the Justice Department's involvement.
segments.tr: Một thẩm phán liên bang đã bác bỏ kiến nghị đó vào tháng 3 năm 2026, cho phép vụ án tiếp tục — một phán quyết mở đường cho sự tham gia của Bộ Tư pháp.

segments.src: ## Why the DOJ Stepped In
segments.tr: ## Lý Do DOJ Can Thiệp

segments.src: Shortly after the dismissal was denied, the Justice Department's Civil Rights Division opened its own investigation into the Evanston program under the Equal Protection Clause and the federal Fair Housing Act.
segments.tr: Ngay sau khi yêu cầu bác bỏ bị từ chối, Bộ phận Dân quyền của Bộ Tư pháp đã mở cuộc điều tra riêng về chương trình Evanston theo Điều khoản Bảo vệ Bình đẳng và Đạo luật Nhà ở Công bằng liên bang.

segments.src: The department has said the city declined to cooperate with that inquiry, which prompted federal attorneys to seek to formally intervene in the private lawsuit rather than pursue a separate case.
segments.tr: Bộ cho biết thành phố đã từ chối hợp tác với cuộc điều tra đó, điều này thúc đẩy các luật sư liên bang tìm cách chính thức can thiệp vào vụ kiện tư nhân thay vì theo đuổi một vụ án riêng biệt.

segments.src: In its filings, the DOJ contends the government has what it calls an "unconditional right" to intervene in cases alleging the denial of equal protection based on race, and argues Evanston's program distributes cash and housing assistance "solely" on the basis of an applicant's race, rather than on individualized proof of harm.
segments.tr: Trong các hồ sơ của mình, DOJ duy trì rằng chính phủ có cái gọi là "quyền vô điều kiện" để can thiệp vào các vụ án cáo buộc việc từ chối bảo vệ bình đẳng dựa trên chủng tộc, và lập luận rằng chương trình của Evanston phân phối tiền mặt và hỗ trợ nhà ở "dựa độc quyền" trên cơ sở chủng tộc của người nộp đơn, thay vì dựa trên bằng chứng cá nhân hóa về tổn hại.

segments.src: The department's proposed complaint asks the court to find the program unlawful under both the Constitution and federal fair-housing law.
segments.tr: Khiếu nại được đề xuất của bộ yêu cầu tòa án ra phán quyết chương trình là trái pháp luật theo cả Hiến pháp và luật nhà ở công bằng liên bang.

segments.src: Evanston officials and reparations advocates have pushed back, arguing the program is a targeted remedy grounded in a documented history of the city's own discriminatory housing practices between 1919 and 1969 — not an open-ended racial preference.
segments.tr: Các quan chức Evanston và những người ủng hộ bồi thường đã phản pháo lại, lập luận rằng chương trình là một biện pháp khắc phục có mục tiêu dựa trên lịch sử được tài liệu hóa về các thực tiễn nhà ở phân biệt đối xử của chính thành phố từ năm 1919 đến năm 1969 — chứ không phải là sự ưu đãi chủng tộc mở rộng.

segments.src: The city's Reparations Committee has said it remains committed to the program while the litigation continues, and some members have framed the case as a test of whether any local government can ever attempt to repair historical harm through direct, race-conscious remedies.
segments.tr: Ủy ban Bồi thường của thành phố cho biết họ vẫn cam kết với chương trình trong khi vụ kiện tụng tiếp tục, và một số thành viên đã đóng khung vụ án như một bài kiểm tra về việc liệu bất kỳ chính quyền địa phương nào có bao giờ có thể cố gắng khắc phục tổn hại lịch sử thông qua các biện pháp khắc phục trực tiếp, có ý thức về chủng tộc hay không.

segments.src: ## Why This Case Matters Beyond Evanston
segments.tr: ## Tại Sao Vụ Án Này Quan Trọng Vượt Ra Ngoài Evanston

segments.src: Evanston's program has been widely cited as a national blueprint since its launch, and other cities and states have looked to it while considering their own reparations proposals.
segments.tr: Chương trình của Evanston đã được trích dẫn rộng rãi như một bản thiết kế quốc gia kể từ khi ra mắt, và các thành phố và tiểu bang khác đã xem xét nó trong khi cân nhắc các đề xuất bồi thường của riêng họ.

segments.src: Legal observers note that a ruling against Evanston could make it significantly harder for other municipalities to design similar programs, while a ruling in the city's favor could bolster the legal footing for reparations efforts elsewhere.
segments.tr: Các nhà quan sát pháp lý lưu ý rằng một phán quyết chống lại Evanston có thể làm cho việc thiết kế các chương trình tương tự trở nên khó khăn hơn đáng kể đối với các đô thị khác, trong khi một phán quyết có lợi cho thành phố có thể củng cố cơ sở pháp lý cho các nỗ lực bồi thường ở những nơi khác.

segments.src: The case is still in its early stages in federal district court in Illinois, and a ruling on the merits is not expected imminently.
segments.tr: Vụ án vẫn đang ở giai đoạn đầu tại tòa án quận liên bang ở Illinois, và một phán quyết về nội dung vụ án không được kỳ vọng sẽ sớm diễn ra.

segments.src: Both the underlying *Flinn* lawsuit and the Justice Department's intervention will need to work through further briefing and, potentially, appeals — meaning the ultimate fate of Evanston's program, and its implications for reparations policy nationwide, likely remain months or years away from resolution.
segments.tr: Cả vụ kiện *Flinn* cơ bản và sự can thiệp của Bộ Tư pháp đều sẽ cần phải thông qua các bản tóm tắt bổ sung và có khả năng là kháng cáo — nghĩa là số phận cuối cùng của chương trình Evanston, và ý nghĩa của nó đối với chính sách bồi thường trên toàn quốc, có lẽ vẫn còn cách xa nhiều tháng hoặc nhiều năm mới có thể giải quyết.
